text:
The median asking rent in Dortmund sits at 9.7 €/m², with a 2.4 % year‑on‑year rise and a 23.2 % gain over the past five years. The 25th‑percentile is 8.4 €/m² and the 75th‑percentile 11.19 €/m², placing the city 29th of 37 German markets.

Market tightness is evident: listings spend only 33 days on market, 22 % are let within a week, and the vacancy rate is 2.1 %. At 582 € per month for a 60 m² unit, the rent‑burden for two residents is 14.4 %, while asking rents sit about 50 % above the 2022 existing‑rent level of 6.45 €/m².

The model‑based forecast expects median asking rents to reach 10.31 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 10.02 €/m² and 10.52 €/m², a 6.2 % increase.
